claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is April 9–12.
ESPN provides TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Thursday-Friday.
CBS provides TV coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament Saturday-Sunday.
Streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Paramount+.
Streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Prime Video.
Streaming of the 2026 Masters Tournament is available on Masters.com.
Coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament includes featured groups.
Coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament includes Amen Corner.
Coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament includes holes 15 & 16.
Early action coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on CBS Sports Network.
Rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament are Thursday-Friday.
Rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament are Saturday-Sunday.
All times in the 2026 Masters TV and streaming schedule are ET.
Prime Video coverage for Rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 1–3 p.m. ET.
Prime Video coverage of Rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is the first time ever.
ESPN coverage for Rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 3–7:30 p.m. ET.
Featured Groups and Holes 4, 5, 6 coverage for Rounds 1 and 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 8:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m. ET on Masters.com/Apps.
Paramount+ coverage for Rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is Noon–2 p.m. ET.
CBS coverage for Rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 2–7 p.m. ET.
Featured Groups and Amen Corner coverage for Rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 11 a.m.–7 p.m. ET on Masters.com/Apps.
Masters.com and App provide free streaming of featured groups and select holes for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
FuboTV allows streaming of ESPN coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
FuboTV allows streaming of CBS coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament.
SiriusXM provides radio coverage of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 2 p.m. to 8 p.m. ET.
